top_signals.headline: EU Prize for Women Innovators 2026 winners announced + Scaleup Europe Fund momentum at EIC Summit Brussels
top_signals.summary: The European Innovation Council named the 2026 EU Prize for Women Innovators laureates at the EIC Summit in Brussels and signaled further capital deployment behind the Scaleup Europe Fund toward women-led deep tech.

top_signals.headline: Phia (Phoebe Gates + Sophia Kianni) reveals $35.5M Series A with 30+ celebrity backers
top_signals.summary: Phia, the AI shopping app, revealed its $35.5M Series A cap table including Kris Jenner, Shakira and Mindy Kaling, with Forerunner leading. A landmark example of celebrity-backed female-founder capital access.

top_signals.headline: Nourish closes $100M Series C, co-founded by Stephanie Liu (Menlo-led)
top_signals.summary: Telehealth nutrition platform Nourish raised $100M in Series C funding led by Menlo Ventures. Stephanie Liu is co-founder. One of the largest female-co-founded health rounds of Q2 2026.

top_signals.headline: Clyx raises $14M Series A - solo Gen Z female founder Alyx van der Vorm
top_signals.summary: Clyx, the personal-connections platform, raised $14M Series A. Alyx van der Vorm built solo from idea to Series A without a co-founder - a counter-narrative to VC co-founder dogma.

top_signals.headline: Saudi Venture Capital appoints Nora Alsarhan as CEO, effective July 1, 2026
top_signals.summary: Saudi Venture Capital (SVC), the sovereign fund-of-funds arm, named Nora Alsarhan as its incoming CEO. Major signal for MENA + GCC gender representation at the LP layer.
